summary: Hipcamp listing LIVE (98% recommended, 607 bookings). Confirmed $66.50 for both RV sites and the always-on 2-night minimum; added a 12-month window and 14-night max, water at the RV sites, 2 RV sites to 50 ft with a drive-through, hot shower/flush toilet/laundry/Wi-Fi. flags: Base rate $66.50 a night is over the US$50 private price gate, and Clearville PA is not within 40 km of a gateway that I know of. Stayed at by the family (--AWH note) and kept before under the min-stay exception, so for AWH to decide.
